digest: The AgriNovus Quadrant event is being presented as the strongest near-term local networking opportunity, largely because it is free, nearby, AI-focused, and built around networking. The useful next move is to test that ranking against Ed’s actual goals and the evidence for who will attend.

The event-tracking and outreach framework is in place, but personalized recommendations and outreach remain limited because Ed’s business description, website, and video links are not available in this matter.

The channel rules are consolidated, and business information is now reportedly available for a personalized AgriNovus outreach draft; the remaining work is to extract the verified details and prepare the message for Ed’s review.
